title: Senior Product Manager: Patient Engagement & AI
jd_excerpt:
Equip Health, a fully virtual eating disorder treatment program, is seeking a Senior Product Manager to shape patient-facing AI across the care journey. You will define how AI connects families, patients, providers, and internal teams, with omnichannel agents and automated workflows that improve access and reduce manual work.

You will design, test, and launch AI agents with Engineering and vendors, while building the foundations to monitor, evaluate, and scale AI in clinical care.
